name: Kawara Ryouta
source:
Hiyoko's childhood friend, Ryouta is a kind and considerate [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rock_pigeon]Rock Dove[/URL]. Although he suffers from a weak stomach (and poor health in general), because his mother is ill, Ryouta is always busy with his part-time jobs to support their household.

[Based on the [URL=http://clione.halfmoon.jp/hatoful-boyfriend/character/ryouta.html]official website[/URL]]
